blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY — A female third-year college student at the Biliran Province State University (BiPSU) in Naval was brought to the school’s guidance office on Monday after allegedly threatening to shoot one of her teachers, prompting a quick response from school officials and police. The incident, reported around 10 a.m., was contained without anyone being hurt, according to BiPSU president Victor Cañezo. Cañezo said the student allegedly sent a text message to one of her classmates threatening a teacher whom she reportedly described as “bad.” READ: Biliran school threat prompts tighter security in Eastern Visayas The classmate then informed school authorities, […]...
